Comparing analyses is less relevant.  The other 2 are quite importnat.

I am imaginge an example where we haev products, orders and customers.  It's much easier to do that with multuple source tbale.s. THis also allows folks to play with queries over data sets with varying lengths.

Filters are often used to filter out bad data or to focus on a region of interst.  It's the field names + threadshols and selected values that is importnat.  The filters can be applied to other views if the same fields are involved (or even if they are not... we should be able to just apply random filters if we want )
They should probably update immediately.  If we allow old and new, it will be a mess to determine how to change each on its own (or how to udpate the snapshot)
Reuse or keep open.  either is fine.  Probably make it easy for the user to "duplciate" a view. Comparison is harder isnce it probalbe requires side by side.  don't worry about that for now,
Choose and build their own.  Also devs can create htem too
We should realistically have a dedicated "filters" section to show these things whcih are not visible on charts otherwise.
I guess suggest 5 tangible things here.  I am struggling to see what htis would be.

Given all this, let's assume taht everything stays "single source" for now.  Clearly multiple sources is its own project.  Maybe we cna go ahead adn run $sleuth to get that separate intent/shape built.

It seems we should be able to store snapshots of the settings as changes are made.  We could diff that and show it.  Or just undo.  It's not clear to me why undo is difficult if state is fully determined by the settings?  What am i missing?
